(WebFetch extraction of Times of Israel live blog, 27 November 2026 — curl blocked; extracted entry text, Reuters-sourced items)

Australia sanctions (5:23 am, Reuters): Australia imposed counterterrorism financing sanctions on Zohair Hassib and Kazem Hamad, whom it says orchestrated 2024 arson attacks on a Sydney kosher restaurant and Melbourne's Adass Israel Synagogue on Iran's behalf. Foreign Minister Penny Wong described the attacks as using a "complex chain of proxies."
Trump on Iran (3:40 am): "Trump downplays China and Russia's support to Iran."
Iran and the Gulf (8:03 am, Reuters): Iran's foreign minister, Abbas Araghchi, told his South Korean counterpart that foreign military presence in the Gulf would raise tensions. South Korea is widening its Cheonghae naval unit's operating area toward the Gulf of Oman.
Erdogan and the Mecca pact (8:06 am, Reuters): Turkey completed ratification of a joint defense agreement with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan, under which an attack on one party is treated as an attack on all.
OPEC (8:45 am, Reuters): The Trump administration reportedly encouraged Venezuela and Iraq to consider leaving OPEC and blocked Venezuela's membership dues. Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman reportedly persuaded Washington not to press the issue further.
